description:
Read a page of visible posts in a WindowsForum thread, oldest first.
Follow pagination.next_offset while pagination.has_more to read the
full conversation, including later replies and accepted solutions.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default: 50, maximum: 100)

offset.description: Number of visible posts to skip (default: 0)

thread_id.description: The thread ID to get posts for

name: get_thread_posts
title: Get thread posts
